# Templates

Copy a file into the right folder, update `id` / `slug` / links, then delete placeholder sections you do not need.

| File | Destination |
|------|-------------|
| [`epic.md`](./epic.md) | `docs/epics/` |
| [`feature.md`](./feature.md) | `docs/features/` |
| [`story.md`](./story.md) | `docs/milestones/<semver>/` |
| [`story-decisions.md`](./story-decisions.md) | Same folder as its story; name `US-NNN-decisions.md` |
| [`task.md`](./task.md) | `docs/milestones/<semver>/` |

See [`../STANDARDS.md`](../STANDARDS.md) for rules.
